title: RIQE: a NIQE-style reference model for CT
description:
A NIQE-style no-reference image quality model fitted on computed tomography instead of natural photographs, together with the validation that the existing literature omits.

The artefact carries the intensity mapping that defines the model (a fixed Hounsfield window, declared as part of the specification), the hyperparameters and the criterion that selected them, the identity of every slice used with its SHA-256, and the identity of the code that produced it. A verification script refits from the same public data and compares, so reproducibility is checkable rather than asserted.

The score is a distance from the declared model, never an absolute judgement of diagnostic quality, and is not comparable with NIQE values in the literature. The model does not know what a lesion is.

Fitted on the CC BY 4.0 Chest and Liver subsets of the TCIA collection LDCT-and-Projection-data (DOI 10.7937/9npb-2637, version 7). Algorithm implemented from Mittal, Soundararajan and Bovik, IEEE SPL 20(3):209-212, 2013; no third-party code incorporated.
notes: Use of this model requires citing the TCIA collection it was fitted on (McCollough et al., Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data, version 7, doi:10.7937/9npb-2637), the foundational TCIA publication (Clark et al., J Digit Imaging 26(6):1045-1057, 2013), and acknowledging NIBIB grants EB017095 and EB017185 (PI: Cynthia McCollough).
